content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lawrenceville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a high school diploma plus years of documented project-work hours. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can help you verify you meet the criteria before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. The instructor-led course covers the entire PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend synchronously from anywhere, ask questions in real time, and receive comprehensive study materials to reinforce each session.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, complete your official PMI application online, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and answer eligibility questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to sharpen your knowledge. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center or at home. On exam day, demonstrate mastery across all five process groups and domains outlined by PMI.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, maintain your credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Pursue training, volunteer projects, or professional activities that strengthen project-management skills. Renew your certification with PMI before expiration to keep the credential active in your career.
